entities.name: Nicol Čupková
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nicol Lucák Čupková is a Slovak ice hockey forward and assistant coach to the Slovak national under-18 team. As a member of the Slovak national ice hockey team, she represented Slovakia at the 2010 Winter Olympics and at six IIHF Women's World Championship tournaments.
